scripts.db:status: pnpm dlx tsx -e "import { DatabasePool } from './packages/core/src/infrastructure/database/DatabasePool.ts'; DatabasePool.getInstance().checkHealth().then(console.log).finally(() => process.exit(0));"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && pnpm db:seed
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tiend3o/shared build && pnpm --filter @tiend3o/core build && pnpm --filter @tiend3o/server build && pnpm --filter @tiend3o/web build
